name: MEV bot 0x00c409 swaps through caller-supplied pools without access control
summary: Selector 0xba381f8f of the unverified arbitrage bot 0x00c40900 takes caller-supplied pool and token addresses and executes the swap legs against them without access control. The attacker passed a fake pool returning fabricated reserves and quotes, so the bot paid out its ETH.
notes: The bot is immutable since its December 2020 deployment. The 868 earlier 0xba381f8f calls (campaign.mjs over its whole history) paid nothing out of it; a copycat in 2025 took 0.0185 ETH.
